because temperature is constant.

According to the first law of thermodynamics, , where is the heat transferred to the system and is the work done by the system. Since in an isothermal process, .

The work done by the gas during the isothermal expansion against a constant external pressure () is given by:

where:

  • = constant opposing pressure = kPa = Pa (since kPa = Pa)

क्योंकि तापमान स्थिर है।

जहाँ:

  • = स्थिर विरोधी दाब = kPa = Pa (चूँकि kPa = Pa)
  • = आयतन में परिवर्तन = dm³ - dm³ = dm³ = m³ (चूँकि dm³ = m³)

J

इसलिए, स्थानांतरित ऊष्मा () की मात्रा J है, इस चिह्न परिपाटी को ध्यान में रखते हुए कि निकाय द्वारा किया गया कार्य ऋणात्मक होता है।
